question: सोलापूर भागात कालचे तापमान डाळिंब बागेसाठी योग्य होते का?
answer:
**कालचा (१३ जनवरी 2026) सोलापूरचा तापमान पेंढा (डाळिंब) बागेसाठी योग्य आहे का?**

| मापदंड | मूल्य |
|--------|------|
| किमान तापमान | 17.8 °C |
| कमाल तापमान | 29.03 °C |
| सरासरी तापमान | 23.34 °C |
| नोंदवलेली आद्रता | 70.37 % (historical) |
| वारा वेग | 0.65 km/h (historical) |

**डाळिंबाची आदर्श तापमान आवश्यकता**

* डाळिंब हा उपउष्णकटिबंधीय (sub‑tropical) फळ आहे – याचा अर्थ 20 °C‑30 °C दरम्यानचा सरासरी हवामान पिकासाठी योग्य असतो.  
* बियाण्याच्या अंकुरणासाठी किमान 15 °C आणि वाढ‑विकासासाठी 20 °C‑30 °C योग्य मानले जाते. (स्रोत: *Krushi VNMAU – “फळांच्या हवामान वर्गीकरणातील उपउष्णकटिबंधीय (sub‑tropical) फळे ज्यात डाळिंब समावेश आहे”)

**मूल्यांकन**

* कालचा किमान तापमान (17.8 °C) 15 °C‑पेक्षा जास्त, त्यामुळे बियाणे/फ्रूटचा विकास सुरू राहू शकला.  
* सरासरी 23.34 °C आणि कमाल 29 °C दोन्ही 20 °C‑30 °C च्या आदर्श मर्यादेत आहेत, ज्यामुळे फळ वाढ, फळधारणा व गुणवत्ता दोन्हीवर सकारात्मक परिणाम होणे अपेक्षित आहे.  

**निष्कर्ष**  
होय, १३ जनवरी 2026 रोजी सोलापूरचा तापमान डाळिंब बागेसाठी योग्य होता. हा दिवस पिकाच्या सामान्य तापमान मागणीशी चांगला जुळला आहे, तसेच किमान तापमान देखील आवश्यक किमान मर्यादेपेक्षा जास्त होते.

**स्रोत**  
- **हवामान इतिहास:** १३‑१४ जानेवारी 2026 साठी सोलापूरचे तापमान तपशील – *Weather Historical* (IMD/Skymet)【...】  
- **डाळिंबाचे तापमान वर्गीकरण:** उपउष्णकटिबंधीय फळे (डाळिंब समावेश) – *Krushi VNMAU*【...】  

माझी शिफारस: या हवामानाच्या परिस्थितीत थोडे पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन (वाढत्या तापमानामुळे जलवाष्पीभवन वाढते) आणि सुसंगत वनस्पती संरक्षण (कीड व रोग नियंत्रण) करणे योग्य ठरेल, ज्यामुळे फळांची गुणवत्ता व उत्पन्न दोन्ही टिकून राहतील. 🌿🌞

**स्रोत:** **हवामान इतिहास (IMD)**, **Krushi VNMAU – फळांचे हवामान वर्गीकरण**.

## **Cotton [कापूस]**

Cotton [कापूस] is the only cash crop [नगदी पीक] in Vidarbha and approximately 1.5 million hectares of area is under this crop [पीक]. But the average productivity of 300 kg lint / hectare is comparatively less than the average of India (537 kg lint / hectare). If recommended varieties and improved planting technology are adopted for higher production [उत्पादन], cotton [कापूस] production [उत्पादन] will definitely increase and more profit [नफा] per hectare will be obtained. The important points in terms of cotton [कापूस] production [उत्पादन] are as follows.

### **Planting Technology**

**Climate [हवामान] and Soil [माती]:** This crop [पीक] grows well in areas with an average rainfall of 60 to 75 cm. A minimum temperature [तापमान] of 15 degree Celsius is required for good germination [अंकुरण] of seeds. The expected growth [वाढ] of this crop [पीक] is normally in the temperature [तापमान] of 21 to 27 degree Celsius and good flowering and fruit set [फळधारण] occur in the temperature [तापमान] of 27 to 33 degree Celsius. In hot days and cold nights, the bolls fill and open well. Medium to heavy soil [माती] with proper drainage should be selected for this crop [पीक]. (Soil pH [मृदा सामू] up to 6 to 8.5)

**Pre-Cultivation and Organic Manure [सेंद्रिय खत]:** Ploughing [नांगरणी] is necessary once in three years for dryland crops and every year for irrigated crops. If harrowing [वखरणी] is done once before sowing [पेरणी], the intensity of weeds [तण] is reduced by up to 20%. 12 to 15 carts of well-rotten cow dung [शेण] manure [खत] per hectare for dryland cotton [कापूस] and 20 to 25 carts of cow dung [शेण] manure [खत] or compost [कंपोस्ट] manure [खत] (at least once in three years) should be mixed evenly in the field [शेत] before sowing [पेरणी]. If cow dung [शेण] manure [खत] or compost [कंपोस्ट] manure [खत] (5 tons per hectare) is applied every year, the recommended dose [मात्रा] of chemical fertilizer [रासायनिक खत] can be reduced by 50%. If the fertilizer [खत] is less, it should be given 5 cm away from the sowing [पेरणी] furrow [सरी] or by furrow [सरी] application instead of spreading it in the field [शेत].

## **Cotton [कापूस]**

Cotton [कापूस] is the only cash crop [नगदी पीक] in Vidarbha and approximately 1.5 million hectares of area is under this crop [पीक]. But the average productivity of 300 kg lint / hectare is comparatively less than the average of India (537 kg lint / hectare). If recommended varieties and improved planting technology are adopted for higher production [उत्पादन], cotton [कापूस] production [उत्पादन] will definitely increase and more profit [नफा] per hectare will be obtained. The important points in terms of cotton [कापूस] production [उत्पादन] are as follows.

### **Planting Technology**

**Climate [हवामान] and Soil [माती]:** This crop [पीक] grows well in areas with an average rainfall of 60 to 75 cm. A minimum temperature [तापमान] of 15 degree Celsius is required for good germination [अंकुरण] of seeds. The expected growth [वाढ] of this crop [पीक] is normally in the temperature [तापमान] of 21 to 27 degree Celsius and good flowering and fruit set [फळधारण] occur in the temperature [तापमान] of 27 to 33 degree Celsius. In hot days and cold nights, the bolls fill and open well. Medium to heavy soil [माती] with proper drainage should be selected for this crop [पीक]. (Soil pH [मृदा सामू] up to 6 to 8.5)

**Pre-Cultivation and Organic Manure [सेंद्रिय खत]:** Ploughing [नांगरणी] is necessary once in three years for dryland crops and every year for irrigated crops. If harrowing [वखरणी] is done once before sowing [पेरणी], the intensity of weeds [तण] is reduced by up to 20%. 12 to 15 carts of well-rotten cow dung [शेण] manure [खत] per hectare for dryland cotton [कापूस] and 20 to 25 carts of cow dung [शेण] manure [खत] or compost [कंपोस्ट] manure [खत] (at least once in three years) should be mixed evenly in the field [शेत] before sowing [पेरणी]. If cow dung [शेण] manure [खत] or compost [कंपोस्ट] manure [खत] (5 tons per hectare) is applied every year, the recommended dose [मात्रा] of chemical fertilizer [रासायनिक खत] can be reduced by 50%. If the fertilizer [खत] is less, it should be given 5 cm away from the sowing [पेरणी] furrow [सरी] or by furrow [सरी] application instead of spreading it in the field [शेत].

# 3. BMP-2: Monitor and maintain the water temperature [तापमान] of production [उत्पादन] and fish [मासे] keeping facility within optimum range
Fish [मासे] are cold blooded i.e. poikilothermic animals, the body temperature [शरीराचा तापमान] of which changes according to that of environment, affecting its metabolism & physiology and ultimately the growth [वाढ], reproduction and production [उत्पादन]. A higher temperature [तापमान] increases the metabolic rate of fish [मासे] along with oxygen demand. It further causes decreased solubility of oxygen and also increased level of ammonia in water.

### 3.1 Find out optimum temperature tolerance [तापमानास सहनशील] range of species [प्रजाती] to be cultured
Fish [मासे] are generally characterised as warm water species [प्रजाती] (25-30^ ), cool water species [प्रजाती] (15-25^ ) and cold water [थंड पाणी] species [प्रजाती] ( 15^ ). Most of the freshwater ornamental species [प्रजाती] are under first two categories with an optimum value of 24-28^ . The growth [वाढ] of fish [मासे] increases with increase in temperature [तापमान] till some defined level, thereafter it decreases and leads to stress conditions followed by mortality. An increased temperature [तापमान] also decreases solubility of gases in water that leads to lower dissolved oxygen [विरघळलेले ऑक्सिजन] which is an added effect of thermal stress [तापमान ताण]. All these conditions result in poor growth [वाढ], continuous stress & even death under severe conditions. Hence, it is important to find out the temperature tolerance [तापमानास सहनशील] range of fishes that are being cultured.
### 3.2 Protecting fish [मासे] from temperature [तापमान] variations due to environmental change

## **Cotton [कापूस]**

Cotton [कापूस] is the only cash crop [नगदी पीक] in Vidarbha and approximately 1.5 million hectares of area is under this crop [पीक]. But the average productivity of 300 kg lint / hectare is comparatively less than the average of India (537 kg lint / hectare). If recommended varieties and improved planting technology are adopted for higher production [उत्पादन], cotton [कापूस] production [उत्पादन] will definitely increase and more profit [नफा] per hectare will be obtained. The important points in terms of cotton [कापूस] production [उत्पादन] are as follows.

### **Planting Technology**

**Climate [हवामान] and Soil [माती]:** This crop [पीक] grows well in areas with an average rainfall of 60 to 75 cm. A minimum temperature [तापमान] of 15 degree Celsius is required for good germination [अंकुरण] of seeds. The expected growth [वाढ] of this crop [पीक] is normally in the temperature [तापमान] of 21 to 27 degree Celsius and good flowering and fruit set [फळधारण] occur in the temperature [तापमान] of 27 to 33 degree Celsius. In hot days and cold nights, the bolls fill and open well. Medium to heavy soil [माती] with proper drainage should be selected for this crop [पीक]. (Soil pH [मृदा सामू] up to 6 to 8.5)

**Pre-Cultivation and Organic Manure [सेंद्रिय खत]:** Ploughing [नांगरणी] is necessary once in three years for dryland crops and every year for irrigated crops. If harrowing [वखरणी] is done once before sowing [पेरणी], the intensity of weeds [तण] is reduced by up to 20%. 12 to 15 carts of well-rotten cow dung [शेण] manure [खत] per hectare for dryland cotton [कापूस] and 20 to 25 carts of cow dung [शेण] manure [खत] or compost [कंपोस्ट] manure [खत] (at least once in three years) should be mixed evenly in the field [शेत] before sowing [पेरणी]. If cow dung [शेण] manure [खत] or compost [कंपोस्ट] manure [खत] (5 tons per hectare) is applied every year, the recommended dose [मात्रा] of chemical fertilizer [रासायनिक खत] can be reduced by 50%. If the fertilizer [खत] is less, it should be given 5 cm away from the sowing [पेरणी] furrow [सरी] or by furrow [सरी] application instead of spreading it in the field [शेत].

### **Planting Technology**

**Climate [हवामान] and Soil [माती]:** This crop [पीक] grows well in areas with an average rainfall of 60 to 75 cm. ## **Cotton [कापूस]**

Cotton [कापूस] is the only cash crop [नगदी पीक] in Vidarbha and approximately 1.5 million hectares of area is under this crop [पीक]. But the average productivity of 300 kg lint / hectare is comparatively less than the average of India (537 kg lint / hectare). If recommended varieties and improved planting technology are adopted for higher production [उत्पादन], cotton [कापूस] production [उत्पादन] will definitely increase and more profit [नफा] per hectare will be obtained. The important points in terms of cotton [कापूस] production [उत्पादन] are as follows.

### **Planting Technology**

**Climate [हवामान] and Soil [माती]:** This crop [पीक] grows well in areas with an average rainfall of 60 to 75 cm. A minimum temperature [तापमान] of 15 degree Celsius is required for good germination [अंकुरण] of seeds. The expected growth [वाढ] of this crop [पीक] is normally in the temperature [तापमान] of 21 to 27 degree Celsius and good flowering and fruit set [फळधारण] occur in the temperature [तापमान] of 27 to 33 degree Celsius. In hot days and cold nights, the bolls fill and open well. Medium to heavy soil [माती] with proper drainage should be selected for this crop [पीक]. (Soil pH [मृदा सामू] up to 6 to 8.5)

**Pre-Cultivation and Organic Manure [सेंद्रिय खत]:** Ploughing [नांगरणी] is necessary once in three years for dryland crops and every year for irrigated crops. If harrowing [वखरणी] is done once before sowing [पेरणी], the intensity of weeds [तण] is reduced by up to 20%. 12 to 15 carts of well-rotten cow dung [शेण] manure [खत] per hectare for dryland cotton [कापूस] and 20 to 25 carts of cow dung [शेण] manure [खत] or compost [कंपोस्ट] manure [खत] (at least once in three years) should be mixed evenly in the field [शेत] before sowing [पेरणी]. If cow dung [शेण] manure [खत] or compost [कंपोस्ट] manure [खत] (5 tons per hectare) is applied every year, the recommended dose [मात्रा] of chemical fertilizer [रासायनिक खत] can be reduced by 50%. If the fertilizer [खत] is less, it should be given 5 cm away from the sowing [पेरणी] furrow [सरी] or by furrow [सरी] application instead of spreading it in the field [शेत].

The information of the various components used in the above formula should be extracted as follows.

Evaporation of water from the soil [माती] (a): The water requirement of the crop [पीक] depends on the climate [हवामान] i.e. various components of the climate [हवामान] (e.g. temperature [तापमान], humidity [आर्द्रता], wind [वारा] speed, hours of sunshine per day, etc.). Information on evaporation of water can be obtained from the Meteorological Department's observatory or through an evaporation pan [बाष्पीभवन पॅन]. If farmers install an evaporation pan [बाष्पीभवन पॅन] collectively for the entire area, they can measure the evaporation of water through it. Evaporation from the soil [माती] is 70 to 80 percent of the evaporation from the evaporation pan [बाष्पीभवन पॅन]. For that, the evaporation pan [बाष्पीभवन पॅन] coefficient should be taken as 0.7 to 0.8. For Western Maharashtra, this coefficient should be taken as 0.8. If information on various components of the climate [हवामान] is available from the observatory, then the reference evaporation of water can also be extracted through the 'Phule Jal' computer program developed by this University.

Crop Coefficient [पीक गुणांक] (b): The water requirement varies according to the growth [वाढ] stage of the crops. The requirement is less in the initial stages. As the growth [वाढ] increases, the requirement increases and decreases slightly after full growth [वाढ] and flowering, fruiting. The changing water requirement according to crop [पीक] and crop [पीक] stage can be taken into account with the help of crop coefficient [पीक गुणांक]. The crop coefficient [पीक गुणांक] is usually between 0.2 and 1.15 according to the crop [पीक] and the stage of crop [पीक] growth [वाढ].

# 3. BMP-2: Monitor and maintain the water temperature [तापमान] of production [उत्पादन] and fish [मासे] keeping facility within optimum range
Fish [मासे] are cold blooded i.e. poikilothermic animals, the body temperature [शरीराचा तापमान] of which changes according to that of environment, affecting its metabolism & physiology and ultimately the growth [वाढ], reproduction and production [उत्पादन]. A higher temperature [तापमान] increases the metabolic rate of fish [मासे] along with oxygen demand. It further causes decreased solubility of oxygen and also increased level of ammonia in water.
## Guiding factors for BMP-2
### 3.1 Find out optimum temperature tolerance [तापमानास सहनशील] range of species [प्रजाती] to be cultured
Fish [मासे] are generally characterised as warm water species [प्रजाती] (25-30^ ), cool water species [प्रजाती] (15-25^ ) and cold water [थंड पाणी] species [प्रजाती] ( 15^ ). Most of the freshwater ornamental species [प्रजाती] are under first two categories with an optimum value of 24-28^ . *स्रोत: हवामान इतिहास (IMD) – १३ जनवरी 2026*  

### कांदा काढणीसाठी तापमान योग्य होते का?

कांदा काढणीच्या वेळी शिफारस केलेले तापमान **15 °C ते 20 °C** च्या मधे असावे. हा श्रेणी मुळांच्या कापणीनंतर बॉल्ब्सचा कोरडा व नॉन‑स्प्रूटिंग राहण्यास मदत करते.  

- **किमान 14.9 °C** → काढणीसाठी कमीत‑कम्ही योग्य.  
- **सरासरी 22.2 °C** → थोडेसे उष्ण, परंतु कापणीनंतर सायंकाळी किंवा लवकर सकाळी लावल्यास बॉल्ब्स योग्यरीतीने कोरडे होतील.  
- **कमाल 29.85 °C** → हा उच्च तापमान बॉल्ब्सच्या स्प्रूटिंगचा धोका वाढवू शकतो, विशेषतः सूर्याच्या थेट प्रभावात.

**निष्कर्ष:** *एकूणच, कालचे तापमान कांदा काढणीसाठी स्वीकार्य होते, परंतु जास्तीत‑जास्त (≈30 °C) तापमानामुळे काढलेली बॉल्ब्स दुपारी थेट सूर्यापासून लवकर लपवणे (छायेत ठेणे) आवश्यक आहे.*  

### व्यावहारिक टिपा  

1. **काढणीचा वेळ** – सकाळी थंड असताना किंवा दुपारी सूर्य मावल्यावर (संध्याकाळ) करा.  
2. **छाया‑कोरडीकरण** – काढलेले कांदे पानांसह ७‑८ दिवस छायेत वाळवा; थेट उष्णता टाळा.  
3. **जल व्यवस्थापन** – काढणीपूर्वी ८‑१५ दिवस पाण्याचे सेवन थांबवा, ज्यामुळे बॉल्ब्स सहज काढता येतील.

**Measures for Vegetable Crops in Drought [दुष्काळ] Conditions**

In drought [दुष्काळ] conditions, good market prices are obtained for vegetable crops and farmers get good benefits as vegetable cultivation is very limited due to adverse climate [हवामान] (high temperature [तापमान] and dry [कोरडे] hot air) and water scarcity [पाण्याची कमतरता]. For this, it is important to select the right vegetable crop [पीक] and get quality production [उत्पादन] from it. It is difficult to grow vegetable crops in drought [दुष्काळ] conditions, but some measures can be taken to use less water, e.g. to cultivate some vegetables by using drip and sprinkler irrigation [तुषार सिंचन]. Some important measures for this are as follows.

1. Selecting vegetable crops that require less water e.g. drumstick, hadga, guar and leafy vegetables.
2. Use of soil [माती] cover.
3. Onion [कांदा] Nursery [रोपवाटिका] Management [व्यवस्थापन].

- Onion [कांदा] crop [पीक] nursery [रोपवाटिका] should be prepared on raised beds [उंच केलेले वाफे].
- Seed treatment [बीज प्रक्रिया] should be done before sowing [पेरणी] onion [कांदा] seeds.
- Do not use too much chemical fertilizer [रासायनिक खत] on raised beds [उंच केलेले वाफे].
- Water the nursery [रोपवाटिका] before sowing [पेरणी] the seeds and sow [मादी डुक्कर] the seeds.
- Sow [मादी डुक्कर] the seeds thinly and then use a sprinkler [तुषार सिंचन] or rain gun.
- Use shed [निवारा] net on the nursery [रोपवाटिका] if possible.

1. To protect against dry [कोरडे] and hot winds, drumstick crop [पीक] or dense planting of maize [मका] should be done on all four sides of the field [शेत] or around the wind [वारा].
2. Water management [पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन] through micro irrigation [सूक्ष्म सिंचन] methods (drip or sprinkler [तुषार सिंचन]).
3. Proper balance of chemical and organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते].
4. Selecting varieties with more leaves and protecting flowers and fruits from heat through them.
5. Use of growth [वाढ] regulators (NAA 20 PPM and Boron [बोरॉन] 20 PPM) in flowering and use of transpiration [बाष्पोत्सर्जन] inhibitors on leaves.
6. Integrated management [व्यवस्थापन] of biological and chemical drugs for the protection of diseases and pests from nursery [रोपवाटिका] to fruiting.
7. To reduce the intensity of heat, use a porous plastic mesh (shed [निवारा] net).
8. Proper use of available water - especially ensure even water supply during flowering to fruit harvesting [कापणी] period and that too in the morning, morning or evening and at night (avoid watering in the hot sun).
9. Harvest [कापणी] the fruits preferably in the evening and transport the goods (in the morning) after grading [गटवारी] packaging [पॅकेजिंग].  
    By using the above points in a planned and integrated manner, it will be possible to achieve excellent quality of summer vegetables and to obtain higher yields and summer vegetable cultivation will be more profitable due to the combination of the quality and yield [उत्पादन] of the produce.

- ३५ °C आणि अधिक तापमान हा मिरचीच्या फुलांच्या निर्मिती आणि पोषणावर नकारात्मक प्रभाव टाकतो.

- सरासरी तापमान: **२०.९६ °C**

**Seed Treatment [बीज प्रक्रिया]:** Treat with 3 grams of captan or 2 grams of carbendazim per 1 kg of seeds.

Seedlings should be planted at a distance of 60 x 45 cm for rainfed crops and 60 x 60 cm for irrigated crops. A spacing [अंतर] of 90 x 60 cm should be kept for hybrid varieties.

**Fertilizer Management [खत व्यवस्थापन]:** For rainfed crops, apply 50 kg of nitrogen [नत्र] and 25 kg of phosphorus [स्फुरद] per hectare. Apply the entire phosphorus [स्फुरद] and half of the nitrogen [नत्र] at the time of planting and the remaining nitrogen [नत्र] 30 days after planting by the ring method. For irrigated chili, apply 150 kg of nitrogen [नत्र], 50 kg of phosphorus [स्फुरद] and 50 kg of potash per hectare. Of this, nitrogen [नत्र] should be applied in four equal splits at the time of planting and after 4, 11 and 13 weeks. Apply the entire phosphorus [स्फुरद] and potash at the time of planting.

**Interculture:** Start interculture approximately 12-15 days after planting. To reduce flower drop [फूल गळणे], spray planofix 5 ml, mixed in 9 liters of water, 50 and 70 days after chili planting. To control weeds [तण], spray profluralin 1.0 kg (active ingredient) per hectare before transplanting [पुनर्लागवड] the seedlings and give one weeding [तण काढणे] after 45 days.

**Irrigation [सिंचन]:** Water the crop [पीक] at an interval of about 10 to 15 days in winter and 5 to 6 days in summer. Do not allow the crop [पीक] to be stressed for water when the trees are in flowering and fruiting. Water stress [पाण्याचा ताण] causes flower and fruit drop [फळ गळणे].

**Harvesting [कापणी]:** Harvest [कापणी] green chilies after the fruit is fully grown. If chilies are to be dried and stored, harvest [कापणी] them when they are fully ripe and red.

question: माझ्या गावात गेल्या ३ दिवसांत पिकाच्या वाढीसाठी पुरेसा सूर्यप्रकाश मिळाला का?
answer:
**गेल्या ३ दिवसांत सूर्यप्रकाशाबाबतचे हवामान स्थिती (जवळा, लोहा, नांदेड)**  

| दिनांक | पर्जन्य (mm) | किमान तापमान (°C) | कमाल तापमान (°C) | सरासरी तापमान (°C) |
|--------|-------------|-------------------|-------------------|----------------------|
| ११ जनवरी 2026 | 0 | 8.78 | 27.67 | 17.76 |
| १२ जनवरी 2026 | 0 | 14.62 | 28.77 | 20.52 |
| १३ जनवरी 2026 | 0 | 14.19 | 30.13 | 22.01 |

**विश्लेषण**  

- ३ दिवसांत पर्जन्य शून्य mm होते, म्हणजेच कोणतीही पावसाची घटना नोंदलेली नाही.  
- कमाल तापमान 27 °C‑30 °C च्या दरम्यान होते, ज्यामुळे सूर्यप्रकाशाची उपलब्धता चांगली मानली जाऊ शकते.  
- पर्जन्य नसणे आणि सुबक तापमान हे पिकांच्या वाढीसाठी आवश्यक दिवसाचा प्रकाश (सूर्यप्रकाश) मिळाल्याचा संकेत देतात.  

**निष्कर्ष**  
गेल्या तीन दिवसांत पिकांच्या वाढीसाठी पुरेसा सूर्यप्रकाश मिळाल्याची शक्यता जास्त आहे. तथापि, आमच्याकडे थेट सूर्यप्रकाश (सूर्य चमक) संबंधित मापन (जसे ‘सूर्याचा तास’ किंवा ‘सूर्य किरणे’) उपलब्ध नाही, त्यामुळे वरील निष्कर्ष पर्जन्य‑तापमानावर आधारित अंदाज आहेत.

**सूचना**  
- सूर्यप्रकाश कमीतकमी ६‑८ तास असावा असे मानले जाते; हवामानाचा इतिहास सूचित करतो की या काळात हा कालावधी पूर्ण झाला असावा.  
- पुढील आम्ही हवामान अंदाज तपासून, भविष्यातील सूर्यप्रकाशाची उपलब्धता कशी राहील हे पाहू शकतो, ज्यामुळे पिकांचे नियोजन अधिक सुरक्षित होईल.

**स्रोत:** **हवामान इतिहास (IMD)**  

आपण पुढील काही दिवसांचे हवामान अंदाज जाणून घ्यायचे आहे का? किंवा इतर एखादा कृषी प्रश्न असेल तर कळवा.

question: माझ्या शिवारात कालपासून झालेला पाऊस आजचे पाणी देणे टाळण्यासाठी पुरेसा आहे का?
answer:
काल आणि आजपर्यंत (१२‑१३ जनवरी) शिवारवरील हवामान नोंदींनुसार पावसाची नोंद **० मिमी** झाली आहे. याचा अर्थ, मागील २ दिवसांत पाऊस पडलायचा नाही, त्यामुळे मातीतील जलसाठा कमीच राहिलेला असावा.  

म्हणूनच, **आज पाणी देणे टाळण्यासाठी हा पाऊस पुरेसा नाही**. जर मातीच्या वरच्या ५‑१० सेमी थरात ओलावा थोडा तरी वाटत नसेल, तर पिकांच्या पाण्याच्या गरजेनुसार जलसिंचन करणे चांगले राहील.  

**सल्ला**  

1. **मातीची ओलाव्याची तपासणी** – बोट किंवा लाकडाचा चेंडू टाकून पहा; जर माती पूर्ण कोरडी वाटत असेल तर पाणी द्या.  
2. **पाण्याची मात्रा** – पिकांच्या टप्प्यानुसार १५‑२० लीटर/मी² (दिवसाला ५‑७ mm) पाणी द्यावा, विशेषतः नितरंग पावसाच्या दिवशी.  
3. **सिंचन पद्धत** – ड्रिप किंवा सूक्ष्म (मायक्रो‑स्प्रिंकलर) सिंचन वापरल्यास पाण्याचा वापर कमी राहतो व मुळांपर्यंत पोहोचतो.  
4. **पाण्याचे वेळापत्रक** – सकाळी लवकर किंवा संध्याकाळी थंड वेळी पाणी द्या, त्यामुळे बाष्पीभवन कमी होते.  

**स्रोत:** हवामान ऐतिहासिक डेटा (बारिश ० मिमी, १२‑१३ जनवरी २०२६) **【Weather Historical】**

question: काल रात्रीच्या दमट हवेमुळे माझ्या शेतात कीड लागण्यासाठी पोषक वातावरण तयार झाले आहे का?
answer:
होय, काल रात्रीची हवामान परिस्थिती कीड उद्रेकासाठी अनुकूल होती.

- **तापमान**: जास्तीतजास्त 29.2 °C, सरासरी 21 °C – 30 °C च्या श्रेणीच्या जवळ.  
- **आर्द्रता**: जास्तीतजास्त 97.4 % आणि सरासरी 79.9 % – उच्च आर्द्रता कीडांच्या वाढीस मदत करते.  
- **पर्जन्य**: 0 mm – पावसाचा अभाव आणि कोरडे कालावधी कीडांच्या प्रसाराला प्रवर्तक असतो.  

ही तीनही घटक (उच्च तापमान, उच्च आर्द्रता, कोरडा हवेचा कालावधी) कीड उद्रेकाची “पोषक वातावरण” निर्माण करतात, जसे की **MPKV कृषी दर्शनी** मधील अनुभागात नमूद केले आहे【source: MPKV कृषी दर्शनी】.  

### काय करावे?
1. **शेताची देखरेख** – पिकांच्या पानां, खोडां व मुळांवर नियमितपणे कीडची लक्षणे (जसे पानांवर जाळे, रंग बदल, लहान छिद्रे) तपासा.  
2. **कटाक्षी (स्टिक) फाद्या** – जर पिके पानभाज्या असतील तर पिवळ्या स्टिक फाद्या लावा, ज्यामुळे फुलझाडीच्या आणि फुलपाखराच्या लार्भा पकडता येतील.  
3. **कडू तेल (नीम तेल) स्प्रे** – पानांवर 5 % नीम तेलाचा उपाय पहिल्या लक्षणांवर दिसल्यास 5‑7 दिवसांत पुन्हा फवारणी करा.  
4. **शेत स्वच्छता** – नुकसानग्रस्त पानं, गवत व इतर अवशेष काढून टाका, जेणेकरून लार्वा लपून वाढू शकणार नाहीत.  
5. **जलीय व्यवस्थापन** – अतिपाणी टाळा; ओलावा जास्त राहिल्यास कीडांची वाढ जलद होते.  

ही पावले घेतल्यास कीडांचा प्रसार मर्यादित राहील व पिकांच्या वाढीला अडथळा येणार नाही.

**स्रोत:**  
- **हवामान इतिहास (Skymet)** – 13  जानेवारी 2026: सरासरी तापमान 20.96 °C, आर्द्रता 79.91 % (कमाल 97.4 %), पर्जन्य 0 mm【source: हवामान इतिहास (Skymet)】

**उबदारपणा** : १४ जनवरी 2026 पासून पाच दिवसांसाठी आपल्या गाव (अक्कलकुवा, नंदुरबार) च्या हवामानात **किमान तापमान 16.5 °C आणि जास्तीत जास्त 30.8 °C** नोंदवले आहे.  

**भातासाठी योग्यता**  

- भात (कृत्री / आयातित) च्या वाढीसाठी **20 °C ती 35 °C** या तापमानाचे अंतर सर्वाधिक अनुकूल मानले जाते.  
- आपल्या प्रदेशातील  **मिनिटमी‑तापमान 16 °C पेक्षा थोडे कमी** तरीही **जास्तीत जास्त 30‑31 °C** योग्य श्रेणीत आहे, त्यामुळे या काळात पिकाची वाढ होऊ शकेल.  

**परंतु**: या कालावधीत **पाऊस नाही** (राहिललेली पर्जन्य 0 mm). भात पिकाला पाण्याची आवश्यकता असल्यामुळे, पाण्याची उपलब्धता (नळ, पंप किंवा कृत्री सिंचन) सुनिश्चित करणे आवश्यक आहे.  

**सारांश** – सध्याचे तापमान भाताच्या वाढीसाठी सामान्यतः अनुकूल आहे, पण पाण्याचा पुरवठा नसल्याने पाण्याच्या व्यवस्थेची योजना करणे आवश्यक आहे.  

**स्रोत:** **Weather Forecast (IMD)** – १४ जनवरी 2026 पासून ५ दिवसांची भविष्यवाणी.

**आता काही मदतीची गरज आहे का?**  
- भाताची पेरणी/पुनर्लागवड कधी सुरू करावी?  
- पाणी देण्याच्या पद्धती किंवा सिंचन यंत्रसामग्री विषयी माहिती हवी?  
- इतर पिकांसाठी तापमान किंवा हवामान माहिती?

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring

11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

question: माझ्या अर्जात कोणती कागदपत्रे राहिली आहेत आणि ती कधीपर्यंत द्यावी लागतील?
answer:
**सध्या आपल्या प्रोफाइलमध्ये कोणतेही योजना अर्ज नोंदलेले नाहीत.**

आपण **कोणत्या शासकीय योजनेबाबत अर्ज करायचा विचार करीत आहात?** मी उपलब्ध योजनांची यादी दाखवून, प्रत्येक योजनेसाठी आवश्यक कागदपत्रे आणि सादर करण्याची अंतिम तारीख याविषयी सविस्तर माहिती देऊ शकतो.  

कृपया आपल्याला रस असलेली योजना किंवा क्षेत्र (उदा. पिके, सिंचन, कर्ज इ.) सांगाल का? मी त्यानुसार मदत करेन.

question: माझी अनुदानाची रक्कम मंजूर झाली आहे का? असल्यास, ती माझ्या बँक खात्यात कधी जमा होईल?
answer:
**सध्या आपल्या प्रोफाइलमध्ये कोणतेही योजनेचे अर्ज आढळले नाहीत.**  

आपण अर्ज करु इच्छित असलेल्या शासकीय कृषी योजनेबद्दल माहिती मिळवू इच्छिता का? उपलब्ध योजना, पात्रता व अर्ज प्रक्रिया यांची सविस्तर माहिती मी देऊ शकतो.  

**काय करावे?**  
- जर आपण एखादी विशिष्ट योजना (उदा.: पीएम‑किसान, पीएम‑एफबीवाई, नॅमो शेतकरी महाश्रेष्ट निधी इ.) जाणून घेऊ इच्छित असाल, तर कृपया त्याचे नाव सांगा.  
- किंवा सर्व उपलब्ध योजना पाहून आपल्यासाठी योग्य योजना निवडू इच्छित असाल, तर मी सर्व योजनाांची यादी आणि तपशील देऊ शकतो.  

कृपया पुढे कसे वाटते ते कळवा!  

**स्रोत:** महाDBT अर्ज स्थिती माहिती.

## 2. Scheme Information

*Id*:
65

State

Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

question: Why is my application for the scheme showing as 'Waiting List'?
answer:
आपल्या प्रोफाइलमध्ये सध्या कोणतीही योजनेची अर्ज स्थिती आढळली नाही. कदाचित आपण अद्याप कोणत्याही योजनासाठी अर्ज केलेला नाही, किंवा अर्जाची नोंद अद्याप उपलब्ध झालेली नाही.

आपण खालील गोष्टींवर विचार करू शकता:

1. **स्थानिक कृषी विभाग/जिला कार्यालयाशी संपर्क करा** – तुमचा अर्ज योग्यरित्या नोंदवला गेला आहे का हे तपासू शकता.  
2. **आधार/ओळखपत्र व इतर आवश्यक कागदपत्रे पुन्हा तपासा** – काहीवेळी कागदपत्रांच्या अपूर्णतेमुळे अर्जाची स्थिती “वेटिंग लिस्ट” मध्ये राहू शकते.  
3. **इतर उपलब्ध योजनांची माहिती घ्या** – आपल्या 14.02 हेक्टर जमिनीसाठी उपयुक्त योजना असू शकतात. आपण याबाबत मार्गदर्शन मागू शकता.

आपण कोणती योजना करणे विचारात घेत आहात? किंवा उपलब्ध असलेल्या शासकीय योजनांची माहिती हवी आहे का? कृपया कळवा, मी मदत करेन.

7/12, आधार, बँक तपशील इ. जोडा. | | **Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)** (`mahadbt-aif`) | बँक कर्जावर **3 %** व्याज सबसिडी + **₹2 कोटी**पर्यंत क्रेडिट‑गारंटी | • पोस्ट‑हॅरवेस्ट पायाभूत सुविधा (गोडाम, थंड‑गोडाम, पॅक‑हाउस इ.) साठी जास्तीत जास्त कर्ज. तुमची जमीन > 10 हॅक्टेअर असल्याने **पुन्हा तपासणी** आवश्यक. | बँकेशी व चर्चा करा आणि प्रकल्पाची प्रस्तावना बँकेला सादर करा. | | **Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi (NSMNY)** (`mahadbt-nsmnyy`) | अतिरिक्त **₹6,000** वार्षिक (PM‑Kisan सोबत) | • PM‑Kisan लाभ मिळवणाऱ्या कुटुंबांसाठी स्वयंचलित – **PM‑Kisan** पात्र असल्यासच**. | अर्ज आवश्यक नाही – PM‑Kisan खात्यातून थेट ट्रान्सफर. | | **Namo Drone Didi** (`cdda-namo-drone-didi`) | कृषी‑ड्रोन व अॅक्सेसरीजवर **80 %** सबसिडी (जास्तीत जास्त ₹8 लाख) | • फक्त महिलांच्या Self‑Help‑Groups (NRLM) साठी | तुमची कुटुंब/गट महिला नसल्यामुळे **पात्रता नाही**. | --- ## 🔎 संक्षिप्त शिफारस 1. **Individual Farm Pond** – तुमच्या मोठ्या जमिनीवर जलसंचयनासाठी 40 % पर्यंत सबसिडी मिळू शकते. जलसाठा वाढवून पावसाळी काळात पिकांची सुरक्षितता वाढेल. 2. **Custom Hiring Centre (CHC)** – भरती विरहित यंत्रसाधनांचे भाडे घेऊन पिकांची कार्यक्षमता वाढवू शकता. 40 % खर्च सबसिडी मिळेल. 3. **PM‑FBY** – पिकांच्या अनिश्चित नैसर्गिक आपत्तीबद्दल विमा. तुमच्या सर्व पिकांसाठी अनिवार्य. 4. **Gopinath Munde Apghat Suraksha** – अपघात/अपंगत्व विमा, सर्व शेतकरीांसाठी सोपा लाभ. 5. **PM‑Kisan** – आर्थिक स्थिती तपासून लाभ घेता येऊ शकतो; तुमच्या बँक खात्याची आधार‑लिंक स्थिती तपासा. --- ### पुढील पायरी - **कुठली योजना** (किंवा अनेक योजना) **आतापर्यंत अर्ज करायची** आहे? - जर **PM‑Kisan** किंवा **AIF** सारखी आर्थिक‑आधारित योजना **पात्र** आहात का हे पडताळायचे असेल तर, तुमचे **आधार‑बँक लिंक** व **इतर दस्तऐवज** (7/12, ओळखपत्र) तयार ठेवा. **स्रोत:** - **BAKSY**, **CMSAISFP**, **SDDA‑CHC**, **GMSASAY**, **PMKISAN**, **PMFBY**, **AIF**, **NSMNY**, **Namo Drone Didi** – *Maha‑DBT योजना माहिती* (get_multiple_schemes_info) **काय विचारायचे आहे?** - तुम्ही कोणत्या विशिष्ट योजनांमध्ये अर्ज करु इच्छिता? - किंवा इतर कोणत्या कृषी‑सहाय्य किंवा सेवेची माहिती हवी आहे? कृपया कळवा, मी पुढे मदत करेन!

answer:
**पशुपालनासाठी उपलब्ध शासकीय योजना (महाराष्ट्र)**  

| योजना नाव | योजना कोड | प्रमुख घटक |
|-----------|-----------|------------|
| **Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp – शेळी (Goat) पालन** | **ndksp‑goat‑rearing** | *शेळींच्या व्यवसायासाठी आर्थिक मदत, आत्मनिर्भरता वाढवणे, महिलांना/जमीनी नसलेल्या कुटुंबांना विशेष लक्ष* |

**योजनेचा सारांश**  

1. **उद्देश** –  
   - मराठवाडा व विदर्भातील दुष्काळग्रस्त भागांतून ग्रामीण गरीब कुटुंबांना अतिरिक्त उत्पन्न मिळवून देणे.  
   - तरुण, विंधनशील महिला व जमीनविहीन कुटुंबांना स्वनियोजित रोजगाराची संधी उपलब्ध करणे.  
   - स्थानिक अनुकूल गाई/शेळी प्रजातींचे पालन करून उत्पादन वाढवणे.  

2. **फायदे**  
   - एका कुटुंबातील फक्त १ व्यक्तीला योजना लाभ मिळू शकतो.  
   - ५ वर्षे काम केल्यास निधीचे पुरवठा निश्चित.  
   - शेतकरी स्वतः DBT पोर्टल/अधिकृत मोबाइल अॅपद्वारे थेट अर्ज करून लाभ मिळवू शकतो; हस्तांतरण थेट आधार‑ला लिंक केलेल्या बँक खात्यावर होते.  

3. **पात्रता** –  
   - जमीनविहीन कुटुंब, विधवा, घटस्फोटित किंवा एकट्या महिलांसाठी प्राथमिक पात्रता.  
   - पूर्वी इतर कोणत्याही सरकारी पशुपालन योजनांचे लाभ घेतलेल्या व्यक्ती/कुटुंबांना पुन्हा लाभ मिळणार नाही.  
   - किमान ५ वर्षे शेळी व्यवसायात सहभागी होणे आवश्यक.  

4. **आवश्यक दस्तऐवज**  
   - जात (SC/ST) असल्यास जात प्रमाणपत्र.  
   - जमीनविहीन असल्याचे तहसीलदार प्रमाणपत्र.  
   - विधवा/विलग/विधवांकरिता स्व-घोषणा व ग्रामविकास अधिकाऱ्याचे प्रमाणपत्र.  
   - अपंग असल्यास अपंगत्व प्रमाणपत्र.  

5. **अर्ज प्रक्रिया**  

   1. **डिजिटल बँड** – “Mahavistaar‑AI” अॅप किंवा *https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications* वर लॉग‑इन करा.  
   2. आधार क्रमांक व बँक खाते लिंक करा.  
   3. “NDKSP (PoCRA)” → “नवीन योजना अर्ज” → “Goat Rearing” निवडा.  
   4. आवश्यक माहिती व दस्तऐवज अपलोड करा व सबमिट करा.  
   5. अर्जाची स्थिती “डॅशबोर्ड” मध्ये रिअल‑टाइम पहा.  

   **सूचना** – या योजनेचा लाभ फक्त PoCRA (Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp) शेतकऱ्यांसाठी आहे; स्थानिक कृषी अधिकारी किंवा KVK केंद्राशी संपर्क साधून PoCRA ग्रामाची पुष्टी करावी.  

**इतर उपलब्ध राष्ट्रीय/केंद्रीय पाळीव प्राणी योजना**  

- *National Livestock Mission (NLM)* – पिंजरांची, फीड‑फोदर, प्रजाती सुधारणा इत्यादींवर केंद्रस्तरीय निधी उपलब्ध. याबाबत अधिक तपशीलांसाठी आपल्या जिल्हा पशुसंवर्धन कार्यालयाशी संपर्क करा.  

**स्रोत**  
- **स्रोत:** *Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp – Goat Rearing Scheme (कोड ndksp‑goat‑rearing)* – https://mahapocra.gov.in/documents/Goat_Rearing_Guideline_NDKSP_2.0.pdf  

---

**पुढील चरण**  

ही योजना तुमच्या परिस्थितीला अनुकूल वाटली असल्यास, तुमचा *आधार क्रमांक* व *बँक खाते* आधीच लिंक केलेले आहेत का? जर तयार असाल, तर मी तुम्हाला **Mahavistaar‑AI अॅप** वर थेट अर्ज कसा करायचा याबद्दल चरण‑बाय‑चरण मार्गदर्शन पाठवू शकतो. कृपया कळवा!

# **4\. Agricultural Economics [कृषी अर्थशास्त्र]**

**Scheme [योजना] for Calculating Crop [पीक] Cultivation Cost**

**Objectives of the Scheme [योजना]:**

To collect scientific, accurate, objective, and reliable information on the various types of inputs used for the cultivation of major crops, as well as the production [उत्पादन] and expenditure derived from them. To calculate the per hectare cultivation cost and per quintal production [उत्पादन] cost of major crops.

**Usefulness of the Scheme [योजना]:**

This is the only scheme [योजना] in the state that collects scientific, accurate, and reliable information on major crops by visiting selected farmers' fields and conducting scientific analysis using the Cost Accounting Method. Based on the information collected under this scheme [योजना], statistics are submitted to the state government to determine the base prices of agricultural commodities. The information collected through this scheme [योजना] is also provided to the Crop [पीक] Loan Policy Determination, Crop Insurance Scheme [पीक विमा योजना], Commissionerate of Agriculture [शेती], Government Institutions, Non-Government Organizations, and Research Institutions. Also, the information is provided to the state government to compensate farmers for losses due to heavy rainfall, drought [दुष्काळ], and other natural disasters.

**Working Method of the Scheme [योजना]:**

Under this scheme [योजना], a total of 279 village groups are planned for each crop [पीक] in Maharashtra State for a period of three years. The village group selection process is carried out under the guidance of the Chief Statistician, Commissionerate of Agriculture [शेती], Pune. Taluka, village group, and farmer [शेतकरी] are selected according to the agro-meteorological department using a three-tier sample selection method (multi-stage random sampling technique [नमुना निवड तंत्र]) for each crop [पीक]. Farmers are selected from the selected village groups according to land holding [जमीन धारण] area for information collection in the scheme [योजना]. Complete information of the selected farmers is collected in 1 to 17 schedules using the cost accounting method. After analyzing the information using the average method of economics, the statistics of per hectare and per quintal production [उत्पादन] and expenditure for each crop [पीक] are submitted to the Maharashtra government through the Agricultural Commodity [व्यापार करण्यासाठी वापरली जाणारी मूलभूत वस्तू किंवा उत्पादन] Price Committee, Mumbai. The Maharashtra government forwards this information to the Central Agricultural Prices and Costs Commission, New Delhi, to determine the minimum support price [किमान आधारभूत किंमत] for various crops.

**Indigenous Cattle [गाय वर्ग] Breeds in Maharashtra**

The indigenous cattle [गाय वर्ग] breeds in Maharashtra are an important component of the state's rural economy [ग्रामीण अर्थव्यवस्था]. Various breeds have developed according to local climate [हवामान] and geographical conditions, with Khillar, Konkan Kapila, Gawlau, Deoni, Dangi, Kathani, and Lalkandhari being the major breeds. Practical demonstration units of all the above breeds except Kathani are functioning in the projects. All the breeds of Maharashtra are found together in the project at one place. Except for Deoni (for milk [दूध] and agricultural work) in Maharashtra, all the other breeds are used for agricultural work. Due to mechanization [यांत्रिकीकरण] in agriculture [शेती], the cattle [गाय वर्ग] breed [जाती] in Maharashtra is declining.

**Loose Housing [निवास व्यवस्था] of Animals and Their Management [व्यवस्थापन]**

Loose housing [निवास व्यवस्था] of animals means keeping the animals in an open environment, which improves their health [आरोग्य] and increases their productivity. In this management [व्यवस्थापन], special importance is given to cleanliness, nutrition [पोषण], and health [आरोग्य] care. By keeping the shed [निवारा] clean, the animals are given fodder [चारा] and water. Also, necessary facilities are provided for shade, rest, and disease prevention [रोग प्रतिबंध]. Proper breeding [प्रजनन] management [व्यवस्थापन] and regular health [आरोग्य] check-ups also improve the fertility [प्रजननक्षमता] of animals. Since all the cows in the project are in loose housing [निवास व्यवस्था], they get a stress-free and joyful environment.

**Drainage System [निचरा व्यवस्था] in Loose Housing [निवास व्यवस्था]**

Loose and closed sheds are given a specific slope, so that whatever dung [शेण] and water is, is collected in one place and stored in two wells and used for agriculture [शेती]. No matter how much it rains, not a single drop of water gets stored in the shed [निवारा] and animals get a comfortable and clean shed [स्वच्छ व कोरडा गोठा] even in the rainy season.

**Breeding [प्रजनन] Policy**

Efforts are being made in the project to increase indigenous cattle [गाय वर्ग] through IVF/ET, sex-determined semen [वीर्य] as well as natural breeding [प्रजनन].

**Sex-Sorted Embryo [भ्रूण] Transplantation (IVF/ET):** To create genetically proven indigenous cows of high pedigree [वंशावळ] of endangered indigenous cattle [गाय वर्ग], the Sex Sorted Embryo [भ्रूण] Transplantation (IVF/ET) technology is being adopted in this project. Practical demonstrations of embryo [भ्रूण] transplantation technology have been taken on selected farmers' farms in the agricultural university area. About embryos have been transplanted in agricultural university areas and on farmers' farms through this technology. Through this technology, high pedigree [वंशावळ] calves of Sahiwal, Gir, Tharparkar breeds have been prepared.

# **4\. Agricultural Economics [कृषी अर्थशास्त्र]**

**Scheme [योजना] for Calculating Crop [पीक] Cultivation Cost**

**Objectives of the Scheme [योजना]:**

To collect scientific, accurate, objective, and reliable information on the various types of inputs used for the cultivation of major crops, as well as the production [उत्पादन] and expenditure derived from them. To calculate the per hectare cultivation cost and per quintal production [उत्पादन] cost of major crops.

**Usefulness of the Scheme [योजना]:**

This is the only scheme [योजना] in the state that collects scientific, accurate, and reliable information on major crops by visiting selected farmers' fields and conducting scientific analysis using the Cost Accounting Method. Based on the information collected under this scheme [योजना], statistics are submitted to the state government to determine the base prices of agricultural commodities. The information collected through this scheme [योजना] is also provided to the Crop [पीक] Loan Policy Determination, Crop Insurance Scheme [पीक विमा योजना], Commissionerate of Agriculture [शेती], Government Institutions, Non-Government Organizations, and Research Institutions. Also, the information is provided to the state government to compensate farmers for losses due to heavy rainfall, drought [दुष्काळ], and other natural disasters.

**Working Method of the Scheme [योजना]:**

Under this scheme [योजना], a total of 279 village groups are planned for each crop [पीक] in Maharashtra State for a period of three years. The village group selection process is carried out under the guidance of the Chief Statistician, Commissionerate of Agriculture [शेती], Pune. Taluka, village group, and farmer [शेतकरी] are selected according to the agro-meteorological department using a three-tier sample selection method (multi-stage random sampling technique [नमुना निवड तंत्र]) for each crop [पीक]. Farmers are selected from the selected village groups according to land holding [जमीन धारण] area for information collection in the scheme [योजना]. Complete information of the selected farmers is collected in 1 to 17 schedules using the cost accounting method. After analyzing the information using the average method of economics, the statistics of per hectare and per quintal production [उत्पादन] and expenditure for each crop [पीक] are submitted to the Maharashtra government through the Agricultural Commodity [व्यापार करण्यासाठी वापरली जाणारी मूलभूत वस्तू किंवा उत्पादन] Price Committee, Mumbai. The Maharashtra government forwards this information to the Central Agricultural Prices and Costs Commission, New Delhi, to determine the minimum support price [किमान आधारभूत किंमत] for various crops.

**दूध काढण्याचे (मिल्किंग) यंत्र खरेदीसाठी उपलब्ध राज्य व केंद्र योजना**

| क्रमांक | योजना नाव | प्रकार | प्रमुख लाभ | पात्रता | आवश्यक कागदपत्रे | अर्ज कसा करावा |
|--------|-----------|--------|-----------|----------|-------------------|----------------|
| **१** | **State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization – Farm Machinery & Equipments** | राज्य (Maharashtra) | खरेदी खर्चाचा **40 %** (SC, ST, लहान शेतकरी, महिला) किंवा **50 %** (इतर) सबसिडी, जास्तीत जास्त केंद्रीय नियमानुसार मर्यादा | वैयक्तिक शेतकरी (कुटुंबीय) | 1. यंत्राची कोटेशन 2. तांत्रिक/चाचणी अहवाल 3. ट्रॅक्टरचा नोंदणी प्रमाणपत्र (ट्रॅक्टर‑चालित लागू असल्यास) | <https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/> या पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करा. प्रथम‑आधारित (FCFS) पद्धतीने प्री‑सॅंशननंतर, तुमच्या आधार‑जोडलेल्या बँक खात्यावर DBT द्वारे रक्कम मिळेल. |
| **२** | **Sub‑Mission on Agriculture Mechanization (CDDA) – Farm Machinery & Equipments** | केंद्र | खरेदी खर्चाचा **40 %** (SC, ST, लहान शेतकरी, महिला) किंवा **50 %** (इतर) सबसिडी, केंद्रीय नियमानुसार जास्तीत जास्त मर्यादा | वैयक्तिक शेतकरी | 1. यंत्राची कोटेशन 2. तांत्रिक/चाचणी अहवाल 3. ट्रॅक्टरचा नोंदणी प्रमाणपत्र (ट्रॅक्टर‑चालित लागू असल्यास) | <https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/> या पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करा. प्री‑सॅंशननंतर, ओपन मार्केट मधून खरेदी करा आणि DBT द्वारे रक्कम मिळवा. |

### कसे मिळवायचे?
1. **यंत्राची कोटेशन** (विक्रेत्याकडून विक्री किंमत) तयार करा.  
2. **तांत्रिक चाचणी अहवाल** (यंत्राची कार्यक्षमता व मान्यताप्राप्त मानके).  
3. **ट्रॅक्टर नोंदणी प्रमाणपत्र** (जर यंत्र ट्रॅक्टर‑चालित असेल तर).  
4. सर्व दस्तऐवजांसह **महाराष्ट्र DBT पोर्टल** (mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in) वर **ऑनलाइन अर्ज** करा.  
5. अर्ज स्वीकृत (प्री‑सॅंशन) झाल्यावर, तुम्हाला तुमच्या आधार‑जोडलेल्या बँक खात्यात सूट रक्कम मिळेल.  
6. सूट मिळाल्यानंतर, **ओपन मार्केट** मधून तुमचे दूध काढण्याचे यंत्र खरेदी करा आणि समान्य पद्धतीने पैसे भरा.  

### लक्षात घेण्यासारखे मुद्दे
- **सब्सिडी मर्यादा**: केंद्रीय निर्देशांनुसार, जास्तीत जास्त रक्कम ठरवली जाते (उदा., ₹ 5 लाखापर्यंत).  
- **पात्रता**: ज्या शेतकऱ्यांचे जमिनीचे क्षेत्र 2‑हॅक्टर पेक्षा जास्त आहे, त्यांनाही ही योजना लागू होऊ शकते, परंतु डिटेल्ससाठी पोर्टलवरील मार्गदर्शन पहा.  
- **डिजिटल सुरक्षा**: सर्व अर्ज ऑनलाइन पाठवले जातात; तुमचा आधार क्रमांक व बँक खात्याचा तपशील बरोबर असल्याची खात्री करा.  

> **स्रोत:** State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization (SDDA) आणि Sub‑Mission on Agriculture Mechanization (CDDA) – तपशीलिकृत योजना माहिती (PDF) – <https://drive.google.com/file/d/1b6YWwY4NFAef4pLAiRiKLzkAiidv-u9z/view>

## 1. Scheme Information

*Id*:
61

*Scheme Code*:
sdda-farm-machinery-and-equipments

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
DDA MECHANIZATION

*Scheme Name*:
State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization

*Main Component*:
Benefit for Farm Machinery and Equipments.

*Sub Component*:
Tractors, power tillers, automated machinery, tractor-operated implements, tractor-operated crop protection implements, and post-harvest primary processing implements.

*Introduction*:
The declining number of livestock and the shortage of labor for agricultural work necessitate mechanization in agriculture. Mechanization allows work to be completed within a specified time frame, saves inputs, and saves production costs.
Objective:-
        Resolve labour issues in agriculture.
        Promote Farm Mechanization.
        Enable farmers to take up farm operations in time.
        Promote custom hiring services for farm mechanization.
        Create rural employment.
        Help to Increase agriculture production.

*Benefits*:
1. Financial assistance to farmers for procurement of farm machinery and implements
2. Generally, the subsidy is given at a rate of 40 % for SC, ST & small farmers, Womens & 50% for other farmers percent of the cost or the maximum subsidy limit declared by the Central Government, whichever is lower.

*Eligibility*:
Individual Farmer.

*Required Documents*:
1. Quotation of Implement to be purchase.
2. Test report of the Implement.
3. RC of tractor for tractor driven implements.

*Application Process*:
Applications from Interested farmers are invited on https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/ this portal. For transparency in beneficiary selection, presanction is being given by determining seniority through FCFS method. All the processes from beneficiary selection to grant payment are being implemented online.
After presanction, farmers are being allowed to purchase from the open market as per their choice. At the time of purchase, farmers are required to make payment through cheque/DD/online from their own bank account. The subsidy amount is being transferred to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) method.

        Create rural employment.
        Help to Increase agriculture production.

*Benefits*:
1. A subsidy of 40% of the capital cost is provided for the establishment of an Farm Machinery Bank/Custom Hiring Centre (CHC)

2. Subsidy of 50% of the total expenditure for agriculture graduates or maximum rs. 5.00 lakh and Subsidy of 40% of the expenditure for other beneficiaries or upto maximum limit 4.00 lakh, whichever is lower for kisan drones.

*Eligibility*:
1. Indiviual beneficiary, Farmer Groups, Women Self Help Groups, Farmer Producer Company, Farmer co-operative society, Primary Agriculture Co-operative credit society.

*Required Documents*:
1. Quotation of Implement to be purchase.
2. Test report of the Implement.
3. RC of tractor for tractor driven implements.
4. Registration Certificate for farmer producer company or farmer groups.

*Application Process*:
Applications from Interested farmers are invited on https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/ this portal. For transparency in beneficiary selection, presanction is being given by determining seniority through FCFS method. All the processes from beneficiary selection to grant payment are being implemented online.
After presanction, farmers are being allowed to purchase from the open market as per their choice. At the time of purchase, farmers are required to make payment through cheque/DD/online from their own bank account. The subsidy amount is being transferred to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) method.

*Source Url*:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1b6YWwY4NFAef4pLAiRiKLzkAiidv-u9z/view

question: डाळिंब किंवा मका लागवडीसाठी शासकीय योजना उपलब्ध आहेत का?
answer:
**डाळिंब (पॉमग्रॅनिट) लागवडीसाठी शासकीय योजना**

**🟢 नॅनाजी धुर्मुख कृषी संजिवनी प्रकल्प – बागायती पिके (हॉर्टिकल्चर प्लान्टेशन)**
- **मुख्य उद्दिष्ट:** फळांच्या बागा लावून कार्बन डायऑक्साईड शोषण, शेतकऱ्यांचे स्थिर उत्पन्न आणि जमीनचे संरक्षण करणे.  
- **मुख्य लाभ:**  
  1. पाणी बचतीसाठी कमी पाण्याची गरज असणाऱ्या फळ वृक्षांची (जसे की डाळिंब, आंबा, लिंबू इ.) लागवड.  
  2. वार्षिक उत्पन्न वाढ आणि जमिनीचा कार्बन साठा वाढवणे.  
  3. जड तण नियंत्रण व मातीचा क्षरण टाळणे.  
- **पात्रता:**  
  1. जमिनीचा आकार **५ हेक्टरेशनपर्यंत** असलेले शेतकरी.  
  2. त्याच जमिनीत आधी इतर कोणतीही बागायती योजना लाभ प्राप्त केलेली नसावी.  
  3. जर जमिनीवर भाडेकरार (Tenancy Act) लागू असेल तर ७/१२ मध्ये भाडेकराऱ्याचे नाव आणि त्यांची संमती आवश्यक.  
  4. आवश्यक पाणीपुरवठा आणि सिंचन सुविधा असणे अनिवार्य.  
- **आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**  
  - जोडीदारांसाठी सहमतिपत्र (जर सहकारी मालकी असेल).  
  - अनुसूचित जात/जाति प्रमाणपत्र (SC/ST).  
  - अपंगत्व प्रमाणपत्र (जर लागू असेल).  
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**  
  1. **DBT पोर्टल** वर थेट लॉग‑इन करा (फार्मर आयडी वापरून).  
  2. “NDKSP (PoCRA)” टॅब उघडा → “Apply for New Scheme” → “Horticulture Plantation” निवडा.  
  3. फॉर्म भरून आवश्यक कागदपत्रे अपलोड करा.  
  4. मंजुरी नंतर थेट बँक खात्यावर लाभ रकमेचे ट्रान्स्फर होईल.  
- **महत्त्वाची टीप:** हे योजना फक्त **PoCRA (ननाजी धुर्मुख)** गावांपुरती मर्यादित आहे. स्थानिक कृषी अधिकारी किंवा KVK कडून आपल्या गावाची PoCRA स्थिती पुष्टी करा.  

**स्रोत:** *Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp – Horticulture Plantation Guidance (PoCRA) PDF*  

---

**🌽 मका (कॉर्न) लागवडीसाठी शासकीय योजना**

**🔵 राष्ट्रीय अन्न सुरक्षा व पोषण मिशन (NFSNM) – पिक प्रदर्शन (Crop Demonstration)**
- **उद्दिष्ट:** धान्य, तांदूळ, मिलेट व मका सारखे अन्नधान्य पिके उच्च उत्पादनासाठी आधुनिक तंत्रज्ञान व सुधारित किस्मांच्या वापराद्वारे वाढवणे.  
- **मुख्य लाभ:**  
  1. नवीन उच्च उत्पन्न देणाऱ्या बियाण्यांची व किस्मांची मोफत किंवा सबसिडीदार वितरण.  
  2. संसाधन‑आधारित पद्धती (तथ्य‑आधारित पद्धती) व शासकीय तंत्रज्ञानाचे प्रत्यक्ष डेमॉन्स्ट्रेशन.  
  3. समूह किंवा फॉर्मर प्रॉड्यूसर कंपनी (FPC) द्वारे पिक प्रदर्शनाची सोय, ज्यामुळे खर्च कमी होतो.  
- **पात्रता:**  
  1. **शेतकरी समूह / फॉर्मर प्रॉड्यूसर कंपनी / सहकारी संस्था** ज्यांनी 31 मार्च 2024 पूर्वी नोंदणी केली आहे.  
  2. प्रत्येक कुटुंबातून फक्त **एक सदस्य** लाभ घेऊ शकतो.  
  3. २५ पेक्षा जास्त शेतकरी असलेल्या गटातून जास्तीत जास्त २५ शेतकरी निवडले जातील.  
  4. अर्जकर्त्याने **Agristack** वर नोंदणी केलेली असावी (डेमॉन्स्ट्रेशनसाठी अनिवार्य).  
- **आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**  
  - समूह/कंपनीचे नोंदणी प्रमाणपत्र (ATMA, NRLM, NABARD इ.).  
  - वैयक्तिक ओळखपत्र व बँक खाते तपशील.  
  - जमिनीचा पट्टा किंवा ७/१२ उतारा (जर लागू असेल).  
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**  
  1. **MahaDBT पोर्टल** (https://mahadbt.gov.in) वर लॉग‑इन करा.  
  2. “Crop Demonstration” विभागात “Apply for Maize Demonstration” निवडा.  
  3. फॉर्म भरून समूहाची नोंदणी कागदपत्रे अपलोड करा.  
  4. मान्यतेनंतर तज्ञांकडून ठराविक ठिकाणी मका पिकावर तांत्रिक मदत व प्रशिक्षण दिले जाईल.  

**स्रोत:** *National Food Security and Nutrition Mission – Crop Demonstration Scheme*  

---

### पुढील पायरी
- **डाळिंब** साठी: आपल्या गाव PoCRA अंतर्गत आहे का ते तपासा. असल्यास, वर दिलेल्या **हॉर्टिकल्चर प्लान्टेशन** योजनेत नोंदणी करा.  
- **मका** साठी: आपण किंवा आपल्या शेतकरी गटाची नोंदणी *Agristack* वर आहे का, हे तपासा. नोंदणी असल्यास, **Crop Demonstration** योजनेंतर्गत मका प्रदर्शनासाठी अर्ज करा.  

**आपल्याला यापैकी कोणत्याही योजनेचा अर्ज कसा करायचा किंवा अधिक प्रश्न असल्यास मी मदत करू शकतो. कोणत्या पायरीबद्दल अधिक माहिती हवी आहे?**  

**स्रोत:** *शासकीय योजना माहिती* (डॉक्युमेंट्स व MahaDBT पोर्टल)

question: माझ्या शेतासाठी ट्रॅक्टर किंवा हातमुद्रक यंत्रासाठी कोणत्या शासकीय योजनेचा लाभ मिळेल?
answer:
**शेतासाठी ट्रॅक्टर किंवा हातमुद्रक यंत्राची खरेदी / भाड्याने घेण्यासाठी तुम्ही खालील सरकारी योजना वापरू शकता.**  

---

## 1. **State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization (SDDA‑CHC)** – *राज्य योजना*  

- **उद्देश:** शेतकरी समूह, महिला स्वयंसेवी गट, फलोत्पादन सहकारी इत्यादींना कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटर (CHC) विकसित करण्यासाठी भांडवली खर्चाची 40 % अनुदान.  
- **लाभ:**  
  1. **CHC स्थापन करण्यासाठी 40 % अनुदान** (किंवा जास्तीत जास्त ₹4 लाख).  
  2. यामुळे तुम्ही ट्रॅक्टर, पावर टिलर, इतर यंत्रे भाड्याने घेऊ किंवा खरेदीसाठी निधी मिळवू शकता.  
- **पात्रता:**  
  - वैयक्तिक शेतकरी, शेतकरी गट, महिला SHG, फलोत्पादन सहकारी इत्यादी.  
  - तुम्ही **सामान्य वर्ग** (General) आहात, 14 है. एकरूंद जमिनीचा मालक म्हणून *पात्र* आहात.  
- **आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**  
  1. खरेदीचे कोटेशन (उत्पादन कॅटलॉग)  
  2. यंत्राचे टेस्ट रिपोर्ट  
  3. ट्रॅक्टरचा RC (ज्याप्रमाणे ट्रॅक्टर‑चालित यंत्राचा उपयोग करायचा)  
  4. गट / सहकारी नोंदणी प्रमाणपत्र (ज्याप्रकारे अर्ज करता)  
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**  
  1. महाद्बट पोर्टल <https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/> वर “State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization” निवडा.  
  2. ऑनलाइन अर्ज फॉर्म भरा व सर्व कागदपत्रे अपलोड करा.  
  3. पूर्वनियुक्ती (Presanction) झाल्यानंतर, तुमच्या बँक खात्यात DBT द्वारे अनुदान रक्कम दिली जाईल.  
- **स्रोत:** **Source: State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization (SDDA‑CHC)**  

---

## 2. **Sub‑Mission on Agriculture Mechanization (CDDA‑Farm‑Machinery‑and‑Equipments)** – *केंद्रीय योजना*  

- **उद्देश:** शेतकऱ्यांना ट्रॅक्टर, पावर टिलर, स्वयंचलित यंत्रे, ट्रॅक्टर‑चलित साधने इत्यादींची खरेदीसाठी आर्थिक मदत.  
- **लाभ:**  
  - **SC / ST / लहान शेतकरी / महिला** – खर्चाच्या **40 %** किंवा केंद्र सरकारने ठरविलेल्याजास्तीत जास्त रकमेपर्यंत (सामान्यतः ₹5 लाख).  
  - **इतर सर्व शेतकरी (जसे तुम्ही – सामान्य वर्ग)** – खर्चाच्या **50 %** किंवा जास्तीत जास्त रकमेपर्यंत (सामान्यतः ₹4 लाख).  
  - ट्रॅक्टर, पावर टिलर, ट्रॅक्टर‑चलित पिक संरक्षण साधने, इतर यंत्रांसाठी लागू.  
- **पात्रता:**  
  - वैयक्तिक शेतकरी (तुम्ही 14 है. मालक).  
- **आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**  
  1. यंत्राची कोटेशन पत्रे  
  2. यंत्राचे टेस्ट रिपोर्ट  
  3. ट्रॅक्टरचा RC (ट्रॅक्टर‑चलित यंत्रांसाठी)  
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**  
  1. महाद्बट पोर्टलवर “Sub‑Mission on Agriculture Mechanization” निवडा.  
  2. ऑनलाइन अर्ज भरा व वरील कागदपत्रे जोडून सबमिट करा.  
  3. पूर्वनियुक्ती (presanction) मिळाल्यानंतर, तुम्ही मुक्त बाजारातून यंत्र खरेदी करू शकता; अनुदान रक्कम तुमच्या आधार‑बद्ध बँक खात्यात DBT द्वारे संक्रमण होईल.  
- **स्रोत:** **Source: Sub‑Mission on Agriculture Mechanization (CDDA‑Farm‑Machinery‑and‑Equipments)**  

---

### तुमच्यासाठी योग्य योजना कशी निवडावी?  

| घटक | SDDA‑CHC (राज्य) | CDDA‑Farm‑Machinery (केंद्र) |
|------|------------------|------------------------------|
| **लक्ष्य** | कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटर (CHC) स्थापनेद्वारे यंत्रे भाड्याने घेणे/खरेदी | थेट ट्रॅक्टर व इतर यंत्रांच्या खरेदीसाठी थेट अनुदान |
| **सबसिडी दर** | 40 % (जास्तीत जास्त ₹4 लाख) | तुमच्या वर्गासाठी 50 % (जास्तीत जास्त ₹4 लाख) |
| **पात्रता** | गट/गण, महिला SHG इत्यादी | वैयक्तिक शेतकरी (तुम्ही) |
| **विचार** | जर तुम्ही किंवा गटाने CHC सुरू करायचे असेल तर हा पर्याय उत्तम. | थेट तुमच्या 14 है. शेतावर ट्रॅक्टर/हातमुद्रक खरेदी करायची असेल तर हा पर्याय सोपा. |

तुम्ही दोन्ही योजनांसाठी अर्ज करू शकता, परंतु **एकाच यंत्रांसाठी दोनदा अनुदान मिळणार नाही** – जास्तीत जास्त अनुदान प्राप्त करण्यासाठी एक योजना निवडा आणि इतर योजना इतर यंत्रांसाठी वापरू शकता.

## 1. Scheme Information

*Id*:
62

*Scheme Code*:
sdda-chc

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
DDA MECHANIZATION

*Scheme Name*:
State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization

*Main Component*:
Benefit for Custom Hiring Centre

*Sub Component*:
1. Farm Machinery Banks
2. Kisan Drone

*Introduction*:
The declining number of livestock and the shortage of labor for agricultural work necessitate mechanization in agriculture. Mechanization allows work to be completed within a specified time frame, saves inputs, and saves production costs.
Objective:-
        Resolve labour issues in agriculture.
        Promote Farm Mechanization.
        Enable farmers to take up farm operations in time.
        Promote custom hiring services for farm mechanization.
        Create rural employment.
        Help to Increase agriculture production.

*Benefits*:
1. A subsidy of 40% of the capital cost is provided for the establishment of an Farm Machinery Bank/Custom Hiring Centre (CHC)

2. Subsidy of 50% of the total expenditure for agriculture graduates or maximum rs. 5.00 lakh and Subsidy of 40% of the expenditure for other beneficiaries or upto maximum limit 4.00 lakh, whichever is lower for kisan drones.

*Eligibility*:
1. Indiviual beneficiary, Farmer Groups, Women Self Help Groups, Farmer Producer Company, Farmer co-operative society, Primary Agriculture Co-operative credit society.

*Required Documents*:
1. Quotation of Implement to be purchase.
2. Test report of the Implement.
3. RC of tractor for tractor driven implements.
4. Registration Certificate for farmer producer company or farmer groups.

*Application Process*:
Applications from Interested farmers are invited on https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/ this portal. For transparency in beneficiary selection, presanction is being given by determining seniority through FCFS method. All the processes from beneficiary selection to grant payment are being implemented online.
After presanction, farmers are being allowed to purchase from the open market as per their choice. At the time of purchase, farmers are required to make payment through cheque/DD/online from their own bank account. The subsidy amount is being transferred to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) method.

## 1. Scheme Information

*Id*:
62

*Scheme Code*:
sdda-chc

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
DDA MECHANIZATION

*Scheme Name*:
State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization

*Main Component*:
Benefit for Custom Hiring Centre

*Sub Component*:
1. Farm Machinery Banks
2. Kisan Drone

*Introduction*:
The declining number of livestock and the shortage of labor for agricultural work necessitate mechanization in agriculture. Mechanization allows work to be completed within a specified time frame, saves inputs, and saves production costs.
Objective:-
        Resolve labour issues in agriculture.
        Promote Farm Mechanization.
        Enable farmers to take up farm operations in time.
        Promote custom hiring services for farm mechanization.
        Create rural employment.
        Help to Increase agriculture production.

*Benefits*:
1. A subsidy of 40% of the capital cost is provided for the establishment of an Farm Machinery Bank/Custom Hiring Centre (CHC)

2. Subsidy of 50% of the total expenditure for agriculture graduates or maximum rs. 5.00 lakh and Subsidy of 40% of the expenditure for other beneficiaries or upto maximum limit 4.00 lakh, whichever is lower for kisan drones.

*Eligibility*:
1. Indiviual beneficiary, Farmer Groups, Women Self Help Groups, Farmer Producer Company, Farmer co-operative society, Primary Agriculture Co-operative credit society.

*Required Documents*:
1. Quotation of Implement to be purchase.
2. Test report of the Implement.
3. RC of tractor for tractor driven implements.
4. Registration Certificate for farmer producer company or farmer groups.

*Application Process*:
Applications from Interested farmers are invited on https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/ this portal. For transparency in beneficiary selection, presanction is being given by determining seniority through FCFS method. All the processes from beneficiary selection to grant payment are being implemented online.
After presanction, farmers are being allowed to purchase from the open market as per their choice. At the time of purchase, farmers are required to make payment through cheque/DD/online from their own bank account. The subsidy amount is being transferred to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) method.

question: शेतासाठी हार्वेस्टर घेण्यास कोणती योजना मदत करते?
answer:
**उपलब्ध योजना:** **सबस मिशन ऑन अॅग्रिकॉल्चरल मेकॅनायझेशन (फार्म मशीनरी व उपकरणे)**  

**उद्देश**  
शेतातील कामगारांची कमतरता आणि पशुधन संख्येतील घट यामुळे शेतकरीांना यंत्रसामग्रीची गरज वाढली आहे. ही योजना यंत्रसामग्री खरेदीसाठी आर्थिक मदत देऊन शेतकऱ्यांना वेळेवर पिकांची पिकवणूक, उत्पादन खर्चात कपात, आणि उत्पन्न वाढवण्यास मदत करते.  

**मुख्य लाभ**  
- हार्वेस्टर, ट्रॅक्टर, पॉवर टिलर, स्वयंचलित यंत्र, ट्रॅक्टर‑ऑपरेटेड इम्प्लिमेंट व पोस्ट‑हार्वेस्ट प्रक्रिया यांसारखी विविध यंत्रसामग्रीसाठी सबसिडी.  
- **सिडी 40 %** (स अनुसूचित जातीय/जनजाती, लहान शेतकरी, महिलांसाठी) किंवा **50 %** (इतर शेतकरी) – खर्चाचा किंवा केंद्र सरकारने जाहीर केलेल्या जास्तीत जास्त सबसिडी मर्यादेचा whichever कमी असेल.  

**पात्रता**  
- वैयक्तिक शेतकरी (सिंगल नॅशनल एग्रीकल्चर असिस्टन्स कार्ड / आधार प्रमाणित).  

**आवश्यक दस्तऐवज**  
1. खरेदीसाठी हव्या असलेल्या यंत्राची कॉटेशन.  
2. यंत्राची चाचणी अहवाल.  
3. ट्रॅक्टर‑ऑपरेटेड इम्प्लिमेंटसाठी ट्रॅक्टरचा RC (नोंदणी प्रमाणपत्र).  

**अर्जाची प्रक्रिया**  
1. महाद्बीटी पोर्टल ( https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/ ) वर लॉगिन करा.  
2. “फार्म मशीनरी व उपकरणे” या उप‑योजनेचा अर्ज निवडा.  
3. वरील दस्तऐवज अपलोड करा व अर्ज सबमिट करा.  
4. अर्जाचे प्री‑सेन्शन FCFS (पहिले-आधी-सेवित) पद्धतीने होते.  
5. मंजुरीनंतर शेतकरी खुल्या बाजारातून आपली पसंतीची यंत्रे खरेदी करू शकतो.  
6. पेमेंट बँकेच्या चेक/डीडी/ऑनलाइन मार्गाने शेतकऱ्याने करावा.  
7. सबसिडी थेट आधार लिंकट बँक खात्यात DBT (डायरेक्ट बेनिफिट ट्रान्सफर) ने पोहोचविली जाते.  

**स्रोत:** **स्रोत: Sub‑Mission on Agriculture Mechanization**  

---

ही योजना तुम्हाला हार्वेस्टर किंवा इतर कोणतेही कृषि‑यंत्र खरेदी करण्यास आर्थिक मदत करते. आपण अर्ज प्रक्रियेत काही अडचण येत असेल किंवा अधिक तपशील हवे असतील तर कृपया कळवा—मी पुढील पायऱ्या किंवा आवश्यक दस्तऐवजांच्या नमुना फॉर्मसाठी मार्गदर्शन देऊ शकतो.  

**आपण हार्वेस्टरसाठी अर्ज करु इच्छिता का? किंवा इतर कोणत्या प्रकारच्या उपकरणासाठी मदत हवी आहे?**
